attributes.name: Illusion-Breaking Strength
attributes.description:
Against Ember season monsters:
When own Illusion-Breaking Strength exceeds the enemy's, for every 150 points of advantage, DMG dealt is increased by 5% (up to 20%) and healing done is increased by 2% (up to 8%, active only in Dungeons and near Field Elites and Bosses).
When own Illusion-Breaking Strength is lower than the enemy's, DMG dealt and healing are greatly reduced, and DMG taken is greatly increased.

Against wild monsters from previous seasons:
DMG dealt is increased by 100%.

The threat level can be judged by the color of the icon above monsters. Monster strength can also be viewed in the Monster Manual and Dungeon Info.
